name: Contra Costa County, CA
findings: Contra Costa County has 3,690 nonprofit organizations. 1,443 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,138 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Contra Costa County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few health care organizations list public events
observations.text: 14 health care organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 35 would.

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 340 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
